ACT_ONE.name: Follow the Rabbit
ACT_ONE.detail: Cross the collapsing canyon and recover the Silver Stopwatch.
ACT_ONE.de: Folge dem Kaninchen über die einstürzende Schlucht.
ACT_ONE.es: Sigue al Conejo por el cañón que se derrumba.

questions.title: The chase begins
questions.story: The Rabbit has seen the Warden. He is racing towards the Rose Canyon while clockwork guards tear the path apart behind him.
questions.de: Das Kaninchen hat den Wächter gesehen. Es rennt zur Rosenschlucht, während Uhrwerkwachen hinter ihm den Weg zerstören.
questions.es: El Conejo ha visto al Guardián. Corre hacia el Cañón de Rosas mientras los guardias destruyen el camino detrás de él.
questions.ask: Look! The Rabbit ___ towards the canyon.
questions.why: “Look!” tells us it is happening now: he is running.

questions.title: Bridge under pressure
questions.story: The bridge collapses. Alice places rose blocks while the Rabbit holds off the guards. The loose pieces are still falling.
questions.de: Die Brücke stürzt ein. Alice setzt Rosenblöcke, während das Kaninchen die Wachen aufhält.
questions.es: El puente se derrumba. Alice coloca bloques de rosa mientras el Conejo detiene a los guardias.
questions.ask: Alice and the Rabbit ___ a new bridge right now.
questions.why: Alice and the Rabbit = they. Use “are building”.

questions.title: The Clockmaker in the rapids
questions.story: A tiny Clockmaker Mouse is carrying the Silver Stopwatch through the rapids. She cannot reach the bank without Alice.
questions.de: Eine kleine Uhrmachermaus trägt die silberne Stoppuhr durch die Stromschnellen.
questions.es: Una pequeña ratona relojera lleva el cronómetro de plata por los rápidos.
questions.ask: ___ the Clockmaker Mouse swimming with the Stopwatch?
questions.why: The Mouse = she. Put “is” before the subject: Is she swimming?

questions.title: One second ahead
questions.story: Alice pulls the Mouse to safety and takes the Stopwatch. The guards are closing the maze gates, but the Rabbit finds one final gap.
questions.de: Alice rettet die Maus und nimmt die Stoppuhr. Die Wachen schließen die Tore des Labyrinths.
questions.es: Alice salva a la ratona y toma el cronómetro. Los guardias cierran las puertas del laberinto.
questions.why: Use they + are not / aren’t + catching.

ACT_ONE.name: Follow the Cat
ACT_ONE.detail: Climb the mirror canopy and steal back the Moon-Mirror Key.
ACT_ONE.de: Folge der Katze hinauf zum Spiegelwald.
ACT_ONE.es: Sigue al Gato hasta el bosque de espejos.

questions.title: A disappearing guide
questions.story: The Cat knows a hidden way into the palace. It jumps between floating platforms, disappearing whenever the guards look up.
questions.de: Die Katze kennt einen geheimen Weg. Sie springt zwischen schwebenden Plattformen und verschwindet vor den Wachen.
questions.es: El Gato conoce un camino secreto. Salta entre plataformas flotantes y desaparece ante los guardias.
questions.why: The Cat = it. For an action in progress, use “is disappearing”.

questions.title: Above the repeating forest
questions.story: The same bird flies past Alice three times. Every loop is shorter. She climbs faster as the forest begins to vanish below.
questions.de: Derselbe Vogel fliegt dreimal an Alice vorbei. Jede Schleife wird kürzer. Sie klettert schneller.
questions.es: El mismo pájaro pasa tres veces. Cada bucle es más corto. Alice sube más rápido.
questions.why: Climb + ing = climbing. Do not double the “b”.

questions.title: The watchers at the mirror
questions.story: Two guards scan the portal. The Cat makes a false grin appear in another tree while Alice moves behind them.
questions.de: Zwei Wachen beobachten das Portal. Die Katze erzeugt in einem anderen Baum ein falsches Grinsen.
questions.es: Dos guardias vigilan el portal. El Gato crea una sonrisa falsa en otro árbol.
questions.why: Question order: What + are + the guards + watching?

questions.title: The key between seconds
questions.story: Alice takes the Moon-Mirror Key. In its reflection she sees the Queen holding a child’s empty chair while the Warden whispers behind her.
questions.de: Alice nimmt den Mondspiegelschlüssel. Darin sieht sie die Königin mit dem leeren Stuhl eines Kindes.
questions.es: Alice toma la Llave del Espejo Lunar. En ella ve a la Reina junto a la silla vacía de una niña.
questions.ask: Complete Alice’s sentence: “I ___ taking the key.”
questions.why: Use “am” after I: I am taking.

CAKE_ROUND.title: Usual size / changing size
CAKE_ROUND.story: The blue half reveals Alice’s normal size. The pink half shows what the magic is doing to her at this moment.
CAKE_ROUND.de: Die blaue Hälfte zeigt Alices normale Größe. Die rosa Hälfte zeigt, wie sie sich gerade verändert.
CAKE_ROUND.es: La mitad azul muestra el tamaño normal de Alice. La mitad rosa muestra cómo está cambiando ahora.
CAKE_ROUND.ask: Alice usually ___ small, but right now she ___ taller.
CAKE_ROUND.why: Routine/state: stays. Happening right now: is getting.

CAKE_ROUND.title: Daily route / action now
CAKE_ROUND.story: The blue half reveals the Rabbit’s daily routine. The pink half shows him racing towards the gate now.
CAKE_ROUND.de: Die blaue Hälfte zeigt den täglichen Ablauf des Kaninchens. Die rosa Hälfte zeigt, wie es gerade zum Tor rennt.
CAKE_ROUND.es: La mitad azul muestra la rutina diaria del Conejo. La mitad rosa muestra que ahora está corriendo hacia la puerta.
CAKE_ROUND.ask: Every morning, the Rabbit ___ his watch, but now he ___ towards the gate.
CAKE_ROUND.why: Repeated routine: checks. Action happening now: is running.

CAKE_ROUND.title: Usual tea / emergency fuel
CAKE_ROUND.story: The blue side shows the Hatter’s normal tea party. On the pink side, he is pouring tea into a boat engine at this moment.
CAKE_ROUND.de: Die blaue Seite zeigt seine Gewohnheit. Auf der rosa Seite gießt er gerade Tee in einen Motor.
CAKE_ROUND.es: El lado azul muestra su costumbre. En el lado rosa está vertiendo té en un motor ahora.
CAKE_ROUND.ask: The Hatter usually ___ tea, but today he ___ it into the engine.
CAKE_ROUND.why: Routine: drinks. Happening today/now: is pouring.

CAKE_ROUND.title: The Gate of Now and Always
CAKE_ROUND.story: Both cakes light up. The final gate will open only if Alice separates a repeated fact from an action in progress.
CAKE_ROUND.de: Beide Kuchen leuchten. Das Tor öffnet sich nur, wenn Alice Gewohnheit und Handlung im Moment unterscheidet.
CAKE_ROUND.es: Los dos pasteles brillan. La puerta solo se abre si Alice distingue un hábito de una acción en progreso.
CAKE_ROUND.ask: The gate usually ___ at noon. Look! It ___ now.
CAKE_ROUND.why: Present simple for the routine: opens. Present continuous for now: is opening.

ACT_TWO.name: Take the Teacup Boat
ACT_TWO.detail: Sail the Reverse River with the Hatter and recover the Teacup Compass.
ACT_TWO.de: Fahre mit dem Hutmacher auf dem rückwärts fließenden Fluss.
ACT_TWO.es: Navega con el Sombrerero por el río que fluye al revés.

questions.title: Tea is fuel now
questions.story: The Hatter’s boat is the only craft moving forwards. He pours his last pot of tea into the engine as the palace bell loses another number.
questions.de: Das Boot des Hutmachers fährt als einziges vorwärts. Er gießt seine letzte Kanne Tee in den Motor.
questions.es: El barco del Sombrerero es el único que avanza. Vierte su última tetera en el motor.
questions.ask: The Hatter is ___ tea into the engine.
questions.why: After “is”, use the ING form: pouring.

questions.title: The river refuses tomorrow
questions.story: Fish, blocks and waterfalls are travelling backwards. Alice steers between fragments of yesterday.
questions.de: Fische, Blöcke und Wasserfälle bewegen sich rückwärts. Alice steuert zwischen Fragmenten von gestern.
questions.es: Peces, bloques y cascadas viajan hacia atrás. Alice navega entre fragmentos de ayer.
questions.ask: The water ___ backwards at the moment.
questions.why: “At the moment” signals present continuous: is moving.

questions.title: The cavern is listening
questions.story: A stone ear wakes whenever somebody speaks. Alice and the Hatter hide while the Warden’s shadow searches the cavern.
questions.de: Ein Steinohr erwacht, sobald jemand spricht. Alice und der Hutmacher verstecken sich.
questions.es: Un oído de piedra despierta cuando alguien habla. Alice y el Sombrerero se esconden.
questions.ask: We ___ now. We are hiding quietly.

questions.title: A compass for one true second
questions.story: They reach an island untouched by the loop. The Hatter gives Alice his compass; it points to the child trapped beyond tomorrow.
questions.de: Sie erreichen eine Insel außerhalb der Schleife. Der Kompass zeigt auf das Kind, das hinter morgen gefangen ist.
questions.es: Llegan a una isla fuera del bucle. La brújula señala a la niña atrapada más allá del mañana.
questions.why: Question order: What + is + the compass + showing?

ACT_TWO.name: Enter the Gear Prison
ACT_TWO.detail: Free the Clockmaker Mouse and recover the Heart Gear.
ACT_TWO.de: Befreie die Uhrmachermaus aus dem Zahnradgefängnis.
ACT_TWO.es: Libera a la Ratona Relojera de la prisión de engranajes.

questions.title: Cells between seconds
questions.story: A friendly card guard opens a tunnel below the palace. Prisoners are trapped inside repeating movements as the gears turn around them.
questions.de: Ein freundlicher Kartenwächter öffnet einen Tunnel. Gefangene sind in sich wiederholenden Bewegungen gefangen.
questions.es: Un guardia de cartas amistoso abre un túnel. Los prisioneros están atrapados en movimientos repetidos.
questions.ask: The prison gears ___ around the cells.

questions.title: The maker of the Crown
questions.story: The Clockmaker Mouse built the Chrono Crown for the Queen. Now a broken gear is pinning her beside the machine she regrets creating.
questions.de: Die Uhrmachermaus baute die Chronokrone. Jetzt hält ein kaputtes Zahnrad sie fest.
questions.es: La Ratona Relojera construyó la Corona del Tiempo. Ahora un engranaje roto la tiene atrapada.
questions.ask: The Clockmaker Mouse is ___ behind the gear.
questions.why: Lie changes to lying: she is lying behind the gear.

questions.title: Turn it by hand
questions.story: The rescue drill has lost its time crystal. Alice and the guard must crank it while the Mouse directs them.
questions.de: Dem Rettungsbohrer fehlt sein Zeitkristall. Alice und die Wache müssen ihn von Hand drehen.
questions.es: El taladro de rescate ha perdido su cristal. Alice y el guardia deben girarlo a mano.

questions.title: The truth inside the Heart Gear
questions.story: Freed at last, the Mouse gives Alice the Crown’s missing Heart Gear. Its memory shows the Queen asking time to keep her daughter safe forever.
questions.de: Die befreite Maus gibt Alice das fehlende Herzrad. Seine Erinnerung zeigt die Bitte der Königin.
questions.es: La ratona liberada entrega a Alice el Engranaje del Corazón. Su recuerdo muestra la petición de la Reina.
questions.ask: Alice and the Mouse ___ the Heart Gear together.
questions.why: Two people = they, so use “are carrying”.

BOSS_ROUND.title: The last battle starts
BOSS_ROUND.story: The Warden fires a wave of stopped time. The Rabbit freezes in mid-air, but Alice’s two recovered relics keep the rest of the party moving.
BOSS_ROUND.de: Der Wächter schießt eine Welle angehaltener Zeit. Das Kaninchen erstarrt mitten im Sprung.
BOSS_ROUND.es: El Guardián lanza una ola de tiempo detenido. El Conejo queda congelado en pleno salto.
BOSS_ROUND.ask: The Warden ___ a time wave now.
BOSS_ROUND.why: The attack is happening now: it is sending a time wave.

BOSS_ROUND.title: Repair the Crown
BOSS_ROUND.story: Alice fits both relics into the Crown while her friends fight the Warden’s shadow creatures. Every correct spell gives them another moving second.
BOSS_ROUND.de: Alice setzt beide Relikte in die Krone ein, während ihre Freunde gegen Schattenkreaturen kämpfen.
BOSS_ROUND.es: Alice coloca las dos reliquias en la Corona mientras sus amigos luchan contra criaturas de sombra.
BOSS_ROUND.ask: Alice and her friends ___ together at the moment.
BOSS_ROUND.why: Alice and her friends = they. Use “are fighting”.

BOSS_ROUND.title: The Queen tells the truth
BOSS_ROUND.story: Behind the wall of tomorrow, Princess Rose reaches for her mother. The Queen finally understands: stopping time is keeping Rose imprisoned.
BOSS_ROUND.de: Hinter der Wand von morgen greift Prinzessin Rose nach ihrer Mutter. Die Königin versteht endlich die Wahrheit.
BOSS_ROUND.es: Detrás del muro del mañana, la princesa Rose tiende la mano. La Reina comprende por fin la verdad.
options: The Queen is understanding the truth.
BOSS_ROUND.why: “Understand” describes a state here. Use present simple: understands.

BOSS_ROUND.title: The shadow loses its shape
BOSS_ROUND.story: The Queen releases the gears. Alice speaks the final spell, and the Warden breaks into black cubes. The door to tomorrow begins to open.
BOSS_ROUND.de: Die Königin lässt die Zahnräder los. Der Wächter zerbricht, und die Tür zu morgen öffnet sich.
BOSS_ROUND.es: La Reina suelta los engranajes. El Guardián se rompe y la puerta al mañana empieza a abrirse.
options: Why the Warden is breaking apart?
Why does the Warden breaking apart?
Why is the Warden breaking apart?
BOSS_ROUND.why: Question order: Why + is + the Warden + breaking apart?

restore.title: Keeper of Now
restore.story: Alice places her relics inside the Crown. The clocks start, Rose steps out of tomorrow, and the Queen finally lets the day end. She gives Alice the Keeper’s Crown—not to control time, but to protect everyone’s right to move through it.
restore.de: Alice setzt ihre Relikte in die Krone. Die Uhren laufen wieder, Rose kehrt zurück, und die Königin lässt den Tag enden. Alice wird zur Hüterin des Jetzt.
restore.es: Alice coloca sus reliquias en la Corona. Los relojes vuelven a funcionar, Rose regresa y la Reina deja que termine el día. Alice se convierte en Guardiana del Ahora.

escape.title: A World Without the Crown
escape.story: Alice breaks the machine and opens the palace doors. Rose, the Queen and every trapped citizen escape into a new forest while the old kingdom becomes a cloud of pink blocks. Nobody owns the next second now.
escape.de: Alice zerstört die Maschine. Rose, die Königin und alle Gefangenen fliehen in einen neuen Wald. Niemand besitzt mehr die nächste Sekunde.
escape.es: Alice rompe la máquina. Rose, la Reina y todos los prisioneros escapan a un bosque nuevo. Ahora nadie es dueño del siguiente segundo.

flicker.title: One More Dawn
flicker.story: The Crown starts, but its new heart flickers. Rose is free and the Warden is gone. The Hatter keeps the gears turning while Alice prepares to search for one last missing grammar rune. Wonderland has a dawn—and a new quest.
flicker.de: Die Krone startet, aber ihr neues Herz flackert. Rose ist frei. Der Hutmacher hält die Zahnräder in Bewegung, während Alice die nächste Suche vorbereitet.
flicker.es: La Corona arranca, pero su nuevo corazón parpadea. Rose está libre. El Sombrerero mantiene los engranajes en marcha mientras Alice prepara otra búsqueda.
